The indicators' labels

Source: R/data-dictionary.R
cd_indicator_labels.Rd

Gives the display label of each indicator, keyed by its code (anc1 -> "ANC 1"). Charts use it to name indicators on an axis, in place of the column names. With a translator the labels are translated (the key of an indicator is opt_<code>); a label that has no translation stays in English, and a code the package does not know is returned as it is.

Usage

cd_indicator_labels(i18n = NULL, indicators = names(.cd_dict_indicator_labels))

Arguments

i18n

Optional translator (i18n$t(key)); without it, the English labels.

indicators

Which indicators, in this order. Default: every indicator the package knows.

Value

A named character vector, code -> label.

Examples

cd_indicator_labels(indicators = c("anc1", "penta3", "instlivebirths"))
#>                        anc1                      penta3 
#>                     "ANC 1"             "Pentavalent 3" 
#>              instlivebirths 
#> "Institutional Live Births"
